name: Admin Block / Director's Office
description: Administrative headquarters housing the Director's Office, Registrar, Admissions, Academic Affairs, and Accounts division.

name: Block 4
description: Department of Computer Science and Engineering featuring AI/ML research labs, software laboratories, and smart classrooms.

name: Block 5
description: Department of Electronics & Communication Engineering and Instrumentation & Control Engineering wings.

name: Old Academic Block (Block 6)
description: Historic academic block housing foundational science departments, physics and chemistry laboratories, and core lecture halls.

name: Block 8A (Connecting)
description: Connecting academic corridor bridging Block 4 and Block 5, containing tutorial rooms and faculty cabins.

name: F-Tech Block
description: Modern multi-storey academic facility housing emerging technology departments, project labs, and multimedia lecture theatres.

name: APJ Hall
description: Premier campus auditorium complex named after Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam, hosting convocations, national symposia, and cultural events.

name: Department of Design
description: Creative hub of NSUT featuring industrial design studios, ergonomics labs, rapid prototyping, and digital media suites.

name: Training and Placement Building
description: Dedicated corporate engagement facility hosting university placement drives, pre-placement talks, and executive interviews.

name: Central Library, SAC & Gym
description: State-of-the-art knowledge repository spanning multi-level reading halls, digital catalog access, Student Activity Center, and gymnasium.

name: Students Centre / Canteen
description: Central social gathering point offering multi-cuisine food stalls, student stationery, common seating, and open-air plaza.

name: Safal
description: On-campus daily retail outlet providing fresh fruits, vegetables, and household groceries to students and residents.

name: Mother Dairy
description: Campus dairy booth providing milk products, ice creams, and refreshing beverages throughout the day.

name: Nescafé Kiosk
description: Popular open-air coffee hub near the administrative lawn serving brewed coffee, iced drinks, and quick snacks.

name: Running Track
description: Standard 400m synthetic running track enclosing the central athletic field and fitness conditioning zone.

name: Cricket Ground
description: Full-size university cricket pavilion featuring turf pitch, boundary seating, and practice net cages.

description: Floodlit concrete basketball courts adhering to FIBA specifications for inter-college tournaments and daily practice.

name: Volleyball Court
description: Outdoor regulation volleyball courts with sand and hard court surfaces.

name: Lawn Tennis Courts
description: All-weather synthetic tennis courts equipped with training wall and perimeter fencing.

name: Raman Hostel

name: Bhaskara Hostel
description: Boys residence hall named after mathematician-astronomer Bhaskara II.

name: Saraswati Hostel
description: Premier girls residence hall with landscaped gardens, indoor dining mess, and round-the-clock security.

name: Alaknanda Hostel

name: Kaveri Hostel
description: Modern girls residence hall located on the north-east residential campus sector.

name: Medical Centre

name: Faculty Housing area 2
description: Senior faculty apartments set amidst green groves in the residential enclave.

name: Faculty Housing area 3
description: Staff and faculty residential units bordering the campus nursery sector.

name: Nursery
description: Campus flora conservation center, plant nursery, and organic composting facility maintaining university green cover.

description: Campus wastewater recycling plant promoting sustainable zero-discharge campus operations.

description: Primary 11kV electrical distribution substation supplying power grid connectivity across the university campus.

name: Electric Substation 2
description: Auxiliary power distribution substation supplying uninterrupted power to labs, IT hubs, and northern hostels.
